feedback.end: Potatoes are a type of tuber. Tubers are a part of some plants that grow underground and hold lots of nutrients. Other examples of tubers are yams and sweet potatoes.
In order to grow their tubers, potato plants need to first spend a lot of time in the dark.
When a potato is buried in the ground, it grows small shoots. Some shoots become roots, and others will grow into the plant that can be seen above ground.

atoms.b: The ((stem)) keeps the bushy potato plant standing tall. White, pink or violet ((flowers)) grow on top of the plant.
The ((berries)) look similar to green tomatoes. However, they should not be eaten as they are very poisonous. The ((leaves)) of the potato plant are poisonous as well.
Underground, the stem meets the ((roots)), whose ends grow thicker and turn into ((tubers)).
